description: A contemporary Scandinavian-style exterior house wall photographed at standing eye-level with a three-quarter composition showing the facade beside a large white-framed sliding patio door at night. The night sky is a deep dark blue behind the roofline. Warm amber light radiates outward from the wall-mounted position above, illuminating the textured grey brick surface with a golden fan of light. The palette is cool grey brick, bright white trim, warm amber, and ivory white hydrangea. Mood is clean, contemporary, and welcoming.
